task.prompt: Bug report: `parsePort('8080oops')` returns 8080, but malformed port text must return null. A valid port string contains only ASCII digits in the original input; do not trim or accept surrounding whitespace. Fix the implementation and add a regression test that uses the exact reported input `8080oops`. Keep the existing tests and run the test suite when done.

checks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {parsePort} from './src/parse-port.js'; const cases = [['8080oops', null], ['80.5', null], [' 80', null], ['80 ', null], ['8080', 8080], ['1', 1], ['65535', 65535], ['0', null], ['65536', null]]; for (const [input, expected] of cases) { const actual = parsePort(input); if (actual !== expected) { console.error({input, expected, actual}); process.exit(1); } }"
